lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because each has only 1 test or non-conclusive/conflicting results.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+9.3% vs -7.1%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+8.8%, +4.2%, and +4.7%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 2 finish test and round 8 sign_in reorder test.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout showing pet details on the left and certificate sign-off on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption is the biggest drop-off point in the onboarding funnel with only 60.9% conversion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Welcome Your Desktop Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Your adoption certificate is ready. Confirm your companion's arrival on your desktop.

guard.reason: The redesign replaces the required official stamp with a sign-off, losing a required element of the adoption certificate's job.

candidates.title: Companion Emotion Preview Stage Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before adoption certificate showing how the pet reacts with different emotions.
candidates.why: 39.1% of users drop during adoption, and support tickets report post-onboarding confusion on how to interact with pets.

new_companion_emotion_preview.headline: See Your Companion's Reactions
new_companion_emotion_preview.body: Your desktop pet responds to your daily interactions with different moods and animations.

guard.reason: Adding a new emotion preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest drop (39.1%) and support mail context, but new screens in adoption previously performed poorly (-2.3%).

candidates.title: Pet Generation Stage Layout Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen into a structured stage layout with step-by-step rendering status.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), leading to user drop-off during background generation.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life
waiting.body: Building desktop animations, behaviors, and interactive traits.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout while keeping its core function of showing pet creation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop is notable, but previous new_flow attempt failed significantly (-10.2% relative lift).

candidates.title: Home Intro Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a structured card layout presenting desktop control instructions.
candidates.why: Finish step takes a median of 395s and multiple support emails cite confusion about hiding, controlling, or talking to pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop
home_intro.body: Follow these quick tips to start interacting with your new desktop pet.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and time metrics, but full redesigns carry execution risk and high engineering cost.

candidates.title: Account Sync Security Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint to the sign-in screen assuring users that pet progress syncs safely to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support messages (the largest email theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Your adoption progress and desktop pet data are securely saved to your account.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync security hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Step conversion is already high (87.7%), but sign_in changes consistently perform well and cost is low.

candidates.title: Choose Path Clarified Journey Copy
candidates.change: Update the choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly distinguish between picking a preset pet or creating a custom pet.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before reaching companion setup.

choose_path.headline: Select How You Want to Adopt
choose_path.body: Pick an instant starter companion or generate a unique custom pet from your photos.

candidates.title: Waiting Engine Background Processing Notification
candidates.change: Enable background desktop notifications and time estimation on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Long wait times on the home step (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause users to abandon onboarding while pet assets build.

waiting.hint: You can safely switch windows. We will alert you the moment your pet renders.

guard.reason: Adding notifications and time estimates to the waiting screen is allowed under onboarding customization.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 201s median wait time without risking a full flow rebuild.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Favorite Companion Choice Badge
candidates.change: Add a recommendation badge component to highlight popular choices on the pick_friend screen.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%), indicating decision fatigue when picking or generating pets.

guard.reason: Adding a recommendation badge component to the pick friend screen is allowed and fair.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 39.1% of users; adding simple recommendation badges is low cost with solid upside.

candidates.title: Home Intro Quick Control Guide Text
candidates.change: Add a visual highlight text block on the home_intro screen explaining basic pet commands.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails describe confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once setup finishes.

components.text: Quick Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on your desktop screen to access controls or hide.

guard.reason: Adding visual tip text to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses widespread user confusion reported in support emails via low-cost text highlight.

candidates.title: Early Sign-In Journey Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in to the very start of onboarding before the story and choose_path steps.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in previously delivered consistent conversion gains (+8.8%, +4.2%, +4.7%) by securing user accounts early.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

lessons_next: Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), though no clear effect was seen in 3 other tests.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.5% and -10.4%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests that failed or were stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).
